# Scene-graph Turtle fixtures

Per-scene Turtle exports from the X3D Example Archives, converted by the
Web3D Consortium via X3dToTurtle.xslt and published alongside each
catalog entry (see https://www.web3d.org/x3d/content/examples/ and the
X3D Semantics page, https://www.web3d.org/x3d/content/semantics/semantics.html).
License: X3D Example Archives open-source license,
https://www.web3d.org/x3d/content/examples/license.html

| Fixture | Source | Exercises |
|---|---|---|
| HelloWorld.ttl | examples/HelloWorld.ttl | Shapes, Material, ImageTexture url, DEF/USE (`-USE-1`) |
| ColorInterpolatorExample.ttl | X3dForWebAuthors/Chapter07EventAnimationInterpolation/ | TimeSensor + ColorInterpolator + ROUTE chain |
| JoeKick.ttl | HumanoidAnimation/Characters/ | HAnimHumanoid skeleton (HAnimJoint hierarchy) |

Retrieved 2026-08-05.
